scientific_limitations: The theorem is a local deterministic equilibrium bifurcation statement for a single explicit equal-patch parameter tuple.
The asymmetric equilibria constructed near the threshold have one unstable direction; they are not locally attracting.
The theorem does not establish global equilibrium counts, global attraction, stochastic behavior or calibrated intervention predictions.
Publication priority is assessed against inspected accessible material, not certified exhaustively.
title: A subcritical migration pitchfork of low-prevalence endemic saddles in two identical patches
